# Introduction

#### Course: Practice: Python Intermediate

## Introduction

Welcome to Practice: Python Intermediate!

This is a complementary course created to work hand-in-hand with our Learn Python Intermediate course. Use this course to practice your understanding of intermediate Python concepts.

Each chapter in this course includes practice problems that correspond to the concepts covered in Learn Python Intermediate.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

![Learn Python Intermediate Course](data:image/png;base64,)

Whenever you are stuck on any practice problems, simply revisit the corresponding chapter of Learn Python Intermediate and try the problem again.

This course helps you solidify your understanding and build confidence in your Python skills.

Let's get started.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
